mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.display_name, u.enabled, u.failed_attempts, u.locked_until, u.last_login_at, u.must_change_password, r.code AS role_code FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( username, password_hash, display_name, enabled, must_change_password ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{enabled}, #{mustChangePassword} )
INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) SELECT #{userId}, id FROM roles WHERE code = #{roleCode} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET failed_attempts = 0, locked_until = NULL, last_login_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username}
UPDATE users SET failed_attempts = failed_attempts + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username}
UPDATE users SET locked_until = NOW() + (#{lockMinutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute'), updated_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username}
